About

Open Legal Artifacts is an open, MIT-licensed project: Arthur's original legal artifacts plus open reimplementations of every artifact in Anthropic's Claude for Legal gallery — deterministic cores where code beats guessing, LLM only where language understanding is genuinely needed.

Source on GitHub: arthrod/open-legal-artifacts. Not legal advice; every output is a first pass for lawyer judgment.
